title: System Design
description: Requirements, APIs, data modeling, scalability, caching, queues, consistency, availability, bottlenecks, and trade-offs.

lessons.title: Requirements and Scope
lessons.summary: Good design starts with functional and non-functional requirements.
lessons.explanation: Good design starts with functional and non-functional requirements. In interviews, explain the concept, when it applies, and the trade-off it introduces. Use concrete examples from the provided material instead of definitions alone.
examples: Define read/write volume before choosing storage.

lessons.title: API and Data Design

lessons.title: Scaling Patterns
lessons.summary: Caching, read replicas, queues, and partitioning address different bottlenecks.

lessons.title: Trade-offs and Failure Modes
lessons.summary: Every design choice trades consistency, latency, complexity, cost, or availability.

coding_challenges.title: System Design status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
